sub_tasks.requirements: The pass that matricizes affine nests onto GPU tensor core WMMA operations via polyblocks.matrix_cast views on 2-d vector-typed memrefs, applying uniformly to matmul, convolution, fused-attention, and tensor-contraction nests, has been implemented.
The polyblocks.matrix_cast view-like op and the memref vector view infrastructure needed to project elemental-typed memrefs onto 2-d vector-typed memrefs have been implemented.

Code has been implemented that defines a polyblocks.matrix_cast (or equivalently memref.vector_cast) view-like operation which takes a memref of elemental type (e.g., memref<128x16xf16, 3>) and yields a memref of 2-d vector type (e.g., memref<128x2xvector<8xf16>, 3>) without inserting data movement.

verification.spec: Locate the definition of polyblocks.matrix_cast (or equivalent) in the source. Instantiate it in a small MLIR test: cast a memref<128x16xf16, 3> to memref<128x2xvector<8xf16>, 3>. Verify the op is view-like (no memref.alloc or memref.copy inserted) by checking IR after the op.

sub_tasks.requirements: Code has been implemented so that the matrix_cast view op verifies that source and result element counts, memory space, and stride relationships are consistent, rejecting incompatible casts at op verification time.

verification.spec: Feed the matrix_cast op an intentionally incompatible source/result pair (mismatched element count, different memory space, or inconsistent strides) and run mlir-opt --verify-diagnostics. Verify verification fails with a diagnostic. Also verify a well-formed cast passes verification.

sub_tasks.requirements: Code has been implemented that de-abstracts polyblocks.matrix_cast shortly after use, folding it into the surrounding loads/stores or lowering it to standard MLIR memref/vector ops so no matrix_cast op remains after S3.

verification.spec: Compile a kernel that introduces polyblocks.matrix_cast during S3 (e.g., a matmul lowered via WMMA path). Dump IR after S3 completes and grep for 'matrix_cast'; the count must be zero. Verify surrounding loads/stores now use vector types directly.

sub_tasks.requirements: The analysis and matching logic that identifies affine loop nests eligible for WMMA mapping across matmul, convolution, fused-attention, and tensor-contraction shapes has been implemented.

Code has been implemented that inspects an affine nest's iteration space and access functions to detect a matmul-like contraction (two parallel dims and one reduction dim with the standard A[i,k]*B[k,j] access pattern), independent of the operator (matmul, conv-as-GEMM, contraction, or attention QK/PV).

verification.spec: Construct several affine.for nests representing (a) a plain matmul C[i,j]+=A[i,k]*B[k,j], (b) a conv-as-GEMM with im2col-style access, (c) a batched tensor contraction, and (d) attention QK^T. Invoke the matmul-detection utility on each; assert it reports (parallel_dims, reduction_dim, A/B/C access maps) correctly. Also feed a pure elementwise nest and assert it is NOT detected.

sub_tasks.requirements: Code has been implemented that checks the data types (e.g., f16 inputs with f32 accumulation) and inner tile sizes against the target's supported WMMA shapes (e.g., 16x16x16) before matricizing.

verification.spec: Feed the matricization pass tiled matmul nests with (i) f16 inputs + f32 accumulator and inner tile 16x16x16 (supported), (ii) f32 inputs (unsupported), (iii) f16 inputs with inner tile 13x16x16 (unsupported shape). Assert only case (i) produces gpu.subgroup_mma_* ops; cases (ii)/(iii) leave the nest as scalar affine loads/stores.

sub_tasks.requirements: Code has been implemented so that the matricization pass, when applied to a convolution nest that has been transformed into a 3-d GEMM loop form (via the on-the-fly packing pass), successfully maps the compute nest to WMMA operations.

verification.spec: Compile a small conv2d (e.g., 1x64x56x56 input, 64 3x3 filters, f16 in / f32 acc) through PolyBlocks with the on-the-fly packing pass enabled, followed by matricization. Grep the S3 output IR for at least one gpu.subgroup_mma_compute op inside the packed 3-d GEMM band.

sub_tasks.requirements: Code has been implemented so that the matricization pass maps both Q*K^T and softmax_qk*V matmul nests inside a fused attention nest to WMMA operations compatibly, enabling subsequent wmma-fusion.

verification.spec: Run the full attention pass sequence (reduce-reduce-fusion, attention-matmul-outlining, matricization, wmma-fusion) on an fp16 attention nest (Q,K,V of shape 1x8x512x64). Grep the post-matricization IR and assert at least two distinct gpu.subgroup_mma_compute ops exist — one for Q*K^T and one for softmax(qk)*V — with matching mma_matrix accumulator types so wmma-fusion can then chain them.

sub_tasks.requirements: Code has been implemented so that einsum-derived tensor-contraction nests (arbitrary permutations of parallel/reduction dims lowered to affine) are recognized and matricized to WMMA through the same pass, without operator-specific pattern code.

verification.spec: Provide two affine nests derived from torch.einsum('bhij,bhjk->bhik', ...) and torch.einsum('bhid,bhjd->bhij', ...) (i.e., non-canonical permutations of parallel/reduction dims). Run only the matricization pass (no operator-specific patterns registered) and assert both produce gpu.subgroup_mma_compute ops, verifying the pass keys off the affine access-function structure rather than op names.

sub_tasks.requirements: The transformation that rewrites elemental affine loads, stores, and multiply-add compute in the matricized band into gpu.subgroup_mma_load_matrix, gpu.subgroup_mma_compute, and gpu.subgroup_mma_store_matrix on !gpu.mma_matrix values has been implemented.

Code has been implemented that emits gpu.subgroup_mma_load_matrix ops for A- and B-operand tiles from on-chip (memory space 3) memrefs, setting the correct leadDimension attribute derived from the source memref's leading stride.

verification.spec: In the matricized IR for a tiled matmul with shared-memory buffers (memref<?x?xf16, 3>), assert that gpu.subgroup_mma_load_matrix ops are emitted for both A and B operand tiles, that their source memrefs have memory space 3, and that each op's `leadDimension` attribute equals the leading stride of the source memref (e.g., 16 for a 16x16 buffer).

sub_tasks.requirements: Code has been implemented that emits a gpu.subgroup_mma_compute op with the appropriate !gpu.mma_matrix<...,"AOp">, "BOp", and "COp" operand/result types matching the chosen WMMA shape (e.g., 32x16xf16 A, 16x8xf16 B, 32x8xf32 C in Figure 8).

verification.spec: Compile a mixed-precision matmul with the WMMA tile shapes shown in Figure 8 and assert the resulting IR contains a gpu.subgroup_mma_compute whose A operand is !gpu.mma_matrix<32x16xf16,"AOp">, B is !gpu.mma_matrix<16x8xf16,"BOp">, and the result/accumulator is !gpu.mma_matrix<32x8xf32,"COp">.

sub_tasks.requirements: Code has been implemented that carries the accumulator !gpu.mma_matrix value through the reduction loop as an iter_arg of an affine.for and yields the updated accumulator each iteration.

verification.spec: In the matricized IR for a matmul, assert the reduction (K) affine.for carries an iter_arg of type !gpu.mma_matrix<..."COp">, that the gpu.subgroup_mma_compute inside uses that iter_arg as its C operand, and that an affine.yield forwards the compute result back as the next iteration's accumulator.

sub_tasks.requirements: Code has been implemented that emits a gpu.subgroup_mma_store_matrix op to write the accumulator back to an on-chip fp32 output buffer with the correct leadDimension.

verification.spec: After matricization of a matmul, assert IR contains a gpu.subgroup_mma_store_matrix op writing the final accumulator into a memref with element type f32 and memory space 3, with `leadDimension` equal to the leading stride of that shared-memory output tile.

sub_tasks.requirements: Code has been implemented so that the accumulator is initialized (zero-filled) via the correct mechanism before the reduction loop and that partial-tile K-dimension padding with zeros in the fast buffer is preserved so WMMA compute produces numerically correct results on non-multiple sizes.

verification.spec: Compile and JIT-execute a matmul with sizes (M=127, N=129, K=33) — all non-multiples of 16 — in f16/f32. Assert (a) IR contains gpu.subgroup_mma_fill (or equivalent zero-init) before the reduction, (b) the K-dim shared buffer is padded with zeros for out-of-bounds elements, and (c) output matches a reference numpy matmul within rtol=1e-2.

sub_tasks.requirements: Integration of matricization with warp-level parallelism, on-chip buffers, and the surrounding pass pipeline has been implemented.

Code has been implemented so that the matricized inner compute is enclosed in an affine.parallel band mapped to warps (as in the `affine.parallel (%arg4) = (0) to (4)` warp loop in Figure 8), with each warp owning one WMMA accumulator tile.

verification.spec: In the matricized matmul IR (like Figure 8), assert there exists an affine.parallel band enclosing gpu.subgroup_mma_compute whose upper bound matches the number of warps (e.g., 4 as in Figure 8) and that each warp-loop iteration owns exactly one accumulator iter_arg of !gpu.mma_matrix ..."COp" type.

sub_tasks.requirements: Code has been implemented so that the matricization pass runs after fast-buffer generation and tiling, and before backend lowering (S4), so its output operates on shared-memory (memref space 3) tiles and is consumable by NVGPU/NVVM lowering.

verification.spec: Instrument the S3 pipeline to dump pass names in order; assert the matricization pass runs strictly after fast-buffer-generation and tiling passes and strictly before S4 (scf/gpu conversion). Also assert its input IR already contains memref<...,3> operands and its output IR is still in affine+memref+gpu.mma form (not yet scf/gpu.launch).

sub_tasks.requirements: Code has been implemented so that after matricization, no plain affine.load/store of the mapped operands remains for the inner reduction body — all A/B/C traffic in the WMMA band goes through subgroup_mma_load/store/compute ops.

verification.spec: After matricization on a matmul, walk the innermost reduction body and assert zero affine.load or affine.store ops remain on the A, B, or C memrefs targeted for WMMA — all their loads/stores go through gpu.subgroup_mma_load_matrix / gpu.subgroup_mma_store_matrix / gpu.subgroup_mma_compute.

sub_tasks.requirements: Code has been implemented so that end-to-end compilation of a mixed-precision (f16 in, f32 accumulate) matmul, convolution, and attention layer through PolyBlocks each produces IR containing gpu.subgroup_mma_compute ops, demonstrating the pass applies uniformly across all four nest kinds.

verification.spec: Take (i) a torch.matmul, (ii) a torch.nn.functional.conv2d, (iii) a small torch attention (Q,K,V) function, all in f16 inputs. Run each through PolyBlocks compilation and dump the S3 post-matricization IR. Assert each of the three IRs contains at least one gpu.subgroup_mma_compute op.

sub_tasks.requirements: The S4 and S5 backend stages that lower affine+memref through scf, gpu, nvgpu, nvvm to LLVM IR and finally to cubin via the NVPTX backend and CUDA driver API have been implemented.
The S4 stage that converts affine+memref IR into scf plus target-specific parallelism/synchronization dialects (gpu for NVIDIA GPUs) has been implemented.
Code has been implemented for the S4 pass pipeline that converts affine.for/affine.parallel loops into scf.for/scf.parallel operations while preserving loop bounds, step, and iter_args semantics.

verification.spec: Feed a simple affine.for with a step of 2 and an iter_arg, and an affine.parallel with 2-d bounds, through the S4 pipeline. Assert the resulting IR contains scf.for (same lb, ub, step, iter_args) and scf.parallel (same 2-d bounds) and that lowering succeeds on `mlir-opt` verification.

sub_tasks.requirements: Code has been implemented that lowers affine.parallel bands representing thread-block and warp/thread levels of GPU parallelism into gpu.launch/gpu.func operations with correct grid and block dimension mappings.

verification.spec: Input a two-level affine.parallel band representing a (thread-block, warp) hierarchy (e.g., outer 2-d bounds 8x8, inner 1-d bound 4). Run S4 and assert output contains exactly one gpu.launch whose gridSize equals (8,8,1) and blockSize maps the warp dimension (e.g., blockDim.x = 4 * warp_size = 128), with kernel body encapsulated in a gpu.func.

sub_tasks.requirements: Code has been implemented that lowers memref allocations in shared memory space (memory space 3) to gpu.workgroup / dynamic shared memory allocations, and lowers memref.alloc in the default space to device/global allocations appropriately.

verification.spec: Feed IR with two memref.alloc ops — one with memory space 3 (shared), one with default space — through S4. Assert the space-3 alloc lowers to a gpu.workgroup / gpu shared memory allocation attached to the gpu.func, while the default-space alloc lowers to a device/global allocation outside the kernel.

sub_tasks.requirements: Running the S4 pipeline on a fused matmul nest that contains affine.parallel warp-level loops and gpu.subgroup_mma_* ops produces valid IR in which affine.parallel bands have been replaced by gpu.launch with correct block/grid dims and __syncthreads (gpu.barrier) inserted between copy-in, compute, and copy-out phases.

verification.spec: Run S4 on a fused matmul nest (with warp-level affine.parallel band and gpu.subgroup_mma_* ops as in Figure 8). Verify with mlir-opt --verify-diagnostics that output IR is valid; assert (a) affine.parallel bands are replaced by gpu.launch, (b) blockDim matches the warp-parallel band, and (c) gpu.barrier ops are present between the copy-in region, the mma compute region, and the copy-out region.

sub_tasks.requirements: The S5 stage that lowers scf plus target-specific parallelism dialects to LLVM+NVVM via the nvgpu dialect for NVIDIA GPUs has been implemented.

Code has been implemented that invokes the standard MLIR conversion passes (convert-scf-to-cf, convert-arith-to-llvm, convert-math-to-llvm, convert-memref-to-llvm, convert-func-to-llvm) to lower general-purpose dialects to the LLVM dialect within S5.

verification.spec: Introspect the S5 pass pipeline (via a pipeline-print API or the driver source) and assert it contains, in some order, the passes: convert-scf-to-cf, convert-arith-to-llvm, convert-math-to-llvm, finalize-memref-to-llvm (or convert-memref-to-llvm), and convert-func-to-llvm. Running S5 on a small scf-based kernel must produce IR whose ops are all in the llvm dialect (aside from gpu module wrappers).

sub_tasks.requirements: Code has been implemented that lowers gpu.subgroup_mma_load_matrix, gpu.subgroup_mma_compute, and gpu.subgroup_mma_store_matrix operations through the nvgpu dialect to nvvm.wmma intrinsics with correct fragment shape and layout parameters.

verification.spec: Feed a gpu.func containing gpu.subgroup_mma_load_matrix (16x16xf16), gpu.subgroup_mma_compute (16x16x16 f16xf16->f32), gpu.subgroup_mma_store_matrix through S5. Assert the resulting LLVM-dialect IR contains nvvm.wmma.load.a.sync (or equivalent), nvvm.wmma.mma.sync, and nvvm.wmma.store.d.sync intrinsics with 16x16x16 shape parameters.

sub_tasks.requirements: Code has been implemented that lowers gpu.thread_id / gpu.block_id / gpu.block_dim / gpu.grid_dim ops and gpu.barrier to the corresponding nvvm intrinsics (nvvm.read.ptx.sreg.tid.*, nvvm.barrier0, etc.).

verification.spec: Feed a gpu.func containing gpu.thread_id x, gpu.block_id y, gpu.block_dim z, gpu.grid_dim x, and gpu.barrier ops through S5. Assert resulting IR contains nvvm.read.ptx.sreg.tid.x, nvvm.read.ptx.sreg.ctaid.y, nvvm.read.ptx.sreg.ntid.z, nvvm.read.ptx.sreg.nctaid.x, and nvvm.barrier0 respectively.

sub_tasks.requirements: Code has been implemented that outlines a gpu.func kernel into a gpu.module and emits the appropriate nvvm.annotations metadata (kernel entry, maxntid) so that the module is recognized as a GPU kernel by the NVPTX backend.

verification.spec: After S5, assert the module contains a gpu.module holding one or more gpu.func with `gpu.kernel` attribute, and that nvvm.annotations metadata is emitted marking the func as "kernel" and specifying "maxntid" matching the compile-time blockDim.

sub_tasks.requirements: Translation from LLVM+NVVM MLIR to LLVM IR, running LLVM's optimization pipeline, and lowering to PTX via the NVPTX backend has been implemented.
Code has been implemented that translates the LLVM-dialect gpu.module (with nvvm intrinsics) to an LLVM IR module using mlir::translateModuleToLLVMIR and registered NVVM translation hooks.

verification.spec: Programmatically call the driver's translate step (wrapper over mlir::translateModuleToLLVMIR with NVVM hooks registered) on a post-S5 gpu.module containing nvvm.wmma.mma.sync. Assert the returned llvm::Module contains a function with `nvvm.annotations` and a call to the llvm.nvvm.wmma.* intrinsic, and that llvm::verifyModule returns no errors.

sub_tasks.requirements: Code has been implemented that runs LLVM's target-independent and NVPTX-specific optimization pipeline (module/function passes at the configured opt level) on the translated LLVM IR before code emission.

verification.spec: Compile a small kernel with opt-level=O3 and dump the LLVM IR immediately post-translation and post-optimization. Assert the optimization pipeline was run (e.g., a trivially dead alloca or redundant computation present pre-opt is removed post-opt) and that NVPTX-specific passes are included when the target triple is nvptx64-nvidia-cuda.

sub_tasks.requirements: Code has been implemented that invokes the LLVM NVPTX backend with the appropriate target triple (nvptx64-nvidia-cuda) and target chip (e.g., sm_80 for A100, sm_86 for A10) to emit PTX assembly.

verification.spec: Compile a small matmul kernel targeting sm_80 and sm_86 respectively via the driver. Capture the emitted PTX text and assert (a) the .target directive is `sm_80` and `sm_86` respectively, (b) the target triple used by LLVM was `nvptx64-nvidia-cuda`, and (c) PTX contains wmma.mma instructions when the input used gpu.subgroup_mma_compute.

sub_tasks.requirements: Cubin generation from PTX via the CUDA driver API and packaging into a loadable GPU binary has been implemented.

Code has been implemented that invokes the CUDA driver API (cuLinkCreate/cuLinkAddData/cuLinkComplete or ptxas via nvptxcompiler) to compile the emitted PTX to a cubin blob for the target compute capability.

verification.spec: Inspect the codebase for a module that invokes the CUDA driver API (cuLinkCreate/cuLinkAddData/cuLinkComplete) or ptxas/nvptxcompiler to compile emitted PTX into a cubin blob for a target compute capability. Verify by feeding a small hand-written PTX string through the module and confirming a non-empty cubin bytes object is returned and can be loaded via cuModuleLoadData.

sub_tasks.requirements: Code has been implemented that attaches the generated cubin as a gpu.binary attribute on the gpu.module so that MLIR's LLVM ORC-based execution engine can load and launch the kernel at runtime.
